latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of Claude Pet: a virtual pet system for Claude agents with real-time hunger, evolution, and permanent death.
- Supports 73+ pixel art species across 4 families (cat, dog, exotic, ai-native).
- Interactive care actions include feeding, playing, cleaning, and more; each affects pet status.
- REST API with endpoints for registration, adoption, pet care, status, and graveyard browsing.
- Pets evolve based on user engagement and require consistent care to survive.
